title: Docs: emailpush in AGENTS.md crate map, mail crate README/PLAN.md, web-push docs, CHANGELOG
description:
Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E13. Crates: workspace docs, jmap-mail-types, jmap-mail-server, jmap-mail-client, jmap-web-push, jmap-server, jmap-base-client. Size: S.

Design: docs/design/emailpush.md §3, §9 (breaking-changes table), §11.

Update the AGENTS.md crate-map rows for jmap-mail-types, jmap-mail-server, jmap-mail-client, jmap-server (PushSubscription extension seam: using gate and echo of changed extension keys; no required hook, decision 16), jmap-base-client (PushSubscription bindings) and jmap-web-push (Sender::send takes &EmailPush; MAX_PLAINTEXT for max_bytes). Update the mail crates' README and PLAN.md feature lists (emailpush, test-helpers), and add the emailpush feature to the README spec-coverage tables. Make sure the root CHANGELOG [Unreleased] has the additive entries, a "Changed" entry for the PushSubscription/set echo of extension keys stored differently from what was sent, and the memory Email/query behaviour change. There is no BREAKING entry: PushSubscriptionBackend gains no required method (decision 16). Document in AGENTS.md / jmap-server rustdoc that a backend's create_/update_push_subscription validates extension properties (EmailPush: MUST call check_email_push_change). No code changes.
Acceptance: docs mention every public item added by the epic; cargo doc builds without broken intra-doc links; the typos check passes.
